LanguageData.VME_SweetTeeth.label: pre-war sugar fixation
LanguageData.VME_SweetTeeth.description:
Snack cakes, candy bars, sugary cereal, and chocolate are treasured tastes of the old world. A proper meal should end with something sweet.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Unlocks the Desserts need
 - Unlocks sowing the cocoa bush
 - The colony receives 15 chocolate at the start
